name: Coverage Factor Voxelization
definition: Computes a scalar-valued voxelization where each voxel stores a coverage factor (percentage of voxel covered by the object), derived from the binary solid voxelization.
summary: Coverage Factor Voxelization computes scalar density values by aggregating 64x supersampled sub-voxel data via an octree, distinguishing itself from binary methods through continuous density estimates.
